products.title: French Cathedral postcards
products.description: Twenty-four cathedrals of France, unbroken. A complete ND Phot booklet, c. 1910s, mint, with original protective tissues.
products.shortDescription: Twenty-four cathedrals of France, unbroken. A complete ND Phot booklet, c. 1910s, mint, with original protective tissues.
products.fullDescription: A complete souvenir booklet of twenty-four postcards, Cathédrales & Églises de France, published by Neurdein Frères under their ND Phot mark, the largest French postcard house of its day. Every card is still bound in, separated by its original protective tissues, with captions in French and English. The kraft cover carries an Art Nouveau vine border. Mint, and kept whole for about a century.
products.medium: Printed postcards on card stock; kraft paper cover; tissue interleaves
products.condition: Mint. All 24 cards present and bound in, original protective tissues between cards; light age toning to kraft cover.
products.tags: nd-phot, neurdein-freres, france, postcards, ephemera, vintage, art-nouveau, collectible, cathedrals, 1910s

products.title: Eastpak U.S.A. Globe Cap
products.description: The old globe, stitched in red.
products.shortDescription: The old globe, stitched in red.
products.fullDescription: A black six-panel cap in cotton twill, cut in the relaxed dad-cap shape. On the front is Eastpak's red globe with "U.S.A." underneath, embroidered: the retro mark from the brand's American roots, now being reissued. Clean, holding its shape, ready to wear.
products.medium: Cotton twill six-panel cap, embroidered logo, curved brim
products.condition: Pre-owned, clean, holds its shape; no visible wear in photos.

products.title: Second Amendment cap
products.description: A souvenir of 2009 America. Eagle, shield, and a punchline, stitched in gold.
products.shortDescription: A souvenir of 2009 America. Eagle, shield, and a punchline, stitched in gold.
products.fullDescription: A black six-panel cap from the late 2000s, when this slogan circulated at American gun shows as a jab at the 'Change' campaign. "I'll Keep My Guns, Money & Freedom" arcs in gold over a bald eagle with a stars-and-stripes shield and a revolver, with "You Keep the Change" beneath. The brown faux-leather brim carries tooled Western scroll stitching. A found artifact of a very specific political moment, with the joke intact.
products.medium: Embroidered cotton twill crown; faux-leather brim with tooled stitching
products.condition: Pre-owned, clean, holds its shape; no maker tag visible.

products.title: The Life and Works of Dalí
products.description: The life and the work, in one spine.
products.shortDescription: The life and the work, in one spine.
products.fullDescription: Nathaniel Harris's illustrated survey of Salvador Dalí, compiled with plates from the Bridgeman Art Library and published by Parragon in 1994. A hardcover with dust jacket, about 79 pages, tracing the life alongside the work.
products.medium: Hardcover with dust jacket, approx. 79 pp., colour plates from the Bridgeman Art Library

products.title: Upcycled Leather Jacket Tote Bag
products.description: A leather jacket, turned into a tote.
products.shortDescription: A leather jacket, turned into a tote.
products.fullDescription: It was a sleeveless leather jacket, a vest, picked up in Madrid. Now it's fused with a reversible canvas into a big tote that actually holds things. Worn one way, it has a cool asymmetric silhouette and hangs low on one side. Flip it, and the green sporty side comes out, finished with a sporty waist strip. Super comfortable, and it still looks like the jacket it was.
products.medium: Upcycled sleeveless leather jacket fused with reversible canvas; sporty waist strip
products.tags: leather, jacket, tote, upcycled, one-of-none, bag

products.title: Upcycled Skirt Tote Bag
products.description: A skirt, turned into a tote.
products.shortDescription: A skirt, turned into a tote.
products.fullDescription: Once a skirt, turned around into the silhouette of a tote. White cloth woven with red and blue vertical stripes, trimmed at the mouth and carried on black faux-leather straps that run down the body, with a funky charm hanging off one. It's lined inside with leftover curtain fabric, also upcycled, and there's a netted laptop pocket that closes with a YKK zip. Nothing new was made for it; everything was already here.
products.medium: Upcycled skirt, upcycled curtain-fabric lining, faux-leather straps, charm, netted pocket with YKK zip
products.imageAlt: White upcycled skirt tote with red and blue vertical stripes and black faux-leather straps, the original skirt turned upside down to form the bag

products.title: Onra — Chinoiseries Pt. 1, 2 & 3 (Limited Box, 300 copies)
products.description: One of 300. Three double albums, a stamped 45, a poster and a jute bag.
products.shortDescription: One of 300. Three double albums, a stamped 45, a poster and a jute bag.
products.fullDescription: The Chinoiseries trilogy in one limited box: three double albums of beats built from Chinese and Asian records, with triptych covers, a stamped bonus 45 of four exclusive tracks, a limited edition 60×30 cm poster and a jute bag. All City Records, 2017. One of 300.
products.medium: 3×2LP with triptych covers, bonus stamped 7-inch (45), limited edition 60×30 cm poster, jute bag
products.condition: Two of the three double albums opened, one still sealed; the limited poster and the bonus 45 still sealed; jute bag included.
products.tags: onra, chinoiseries, vinyl, box-set, limited, all-city-records, instrumental-hip-hop

products.description: The Ninth and the Eighth, Vienna 1965. Japanese Super Analogue pressing, sealed.
products.shortDescription: The Ninth and the Eighth, Vienna 1965. Japanese Super Analogue pressing, sealed.

products.description: A decade-defining record, held in hand.
products.shortDescription: A decade-defining record, held in hand.
products.fullDescription: My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy on three records from Roc-A-Fella, in the red sleeve with George Condo's ballerina painting framed in its window. products.title: Rick Owens Dark Shadow × Dr. Martens Steel Toe Boots, 2025
products.description: A work boot, raised and wrapped in Rick's laces.
products.shortDescription: A work boot, raised and wrapped in Rick's laces.
products.fullDescription: Rick Owens and Dr. Martens' Fall/Winter 2025 steel toe boot: a traditional work boot subverted. Black waxy, matte leather over a hardened steel toe cap, eleven eyelets and speed hooks, an exaggerated geometric tongue, and Rick's extra-long wraparound laces circling the ankle. Brushed silver inner zip and hardware, a custom AirWair heel loop, and a towering Quad platform sole held with pearl welt stitching.
products.medium: Waxy black leather upper, steel toe cap, Quad platform sole, palladium hardware, side zip, wraparound laces
products.tags: rick-owens, dr-martens, boots, footwear, collaboration, avant-garde
products.imageAlt: Black Rick Owens x Dr. Martens steel toe boots with grey wraparound laces and Quad platform sole

products.title: Corteiz × Boy Better Know Shuku Jacket
products.description: Grime royalty, zipped in black nylon.
products.shortDescription: Grime royalty, zipped in black nylon.
products.fullDescription: Corteiz and Boy Better Know's Shuku jacket, released in spring/summer 2025 for twenty years of Skepta and JME's crew. Black crinkle nylon with black mesh panels, cut through by curved reflective piping. On the front is the white Corteiz script at the chest; on the back is BOY BETTER KNOW in large cream crinkle letters, with the Alcatraz badge below the yoke. Full zip, stand collar, elastic cuffs and a drawcord hem. Two London institutions on one jacket.
products.medium: Crinkle nylon shell with mesh panels, reflective piping, appliqué back lettering
products.condition: Pre-owned, clean; lettering and piping intact.
products.tags: corteiz, boy-better-know, bbk, skepta, jacket, london, streetwear
products.imageAlt: Black Corteiz x Boy Better Know nylon and mesh track jacket, BOY BETTER KNOW lettering on the back

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Reversible Jacket, 1990s
products.description: Bottle green one way, cream the other.
products.shortDescription: Bottle green one way, cream the other.
products.fullDescription: A vintage Yves Saint Laurent reversible jacket from the 1990s. One side is bottle-green cotton with a cream YSL monogram at the chest; turn it inside out and it's cream. The stand collar is lined in green with YVES SAINT LAURENT in gold lettering, and cream shows at the placket and snap cuffs. Zip and snap front, two flap patch pockets. Two jackets in one, from the house's ready-to-wear years.
products.medium: Reversible cotton-blend shell, embroidered YSL monogram, printed collar logo
products.tags: ysl, yves-saint-laurent, vintage, reversible, jacket, outerwear
products.imageAlt: Vintage YSL reversible jacket, bottle green with cream lining and gold Yves Saint Laurent collar logo

products.title: Nils Frahm — Spaces (2×LP, Rough Trade copy)
products.description: Live recordings, with the Rough Trade sticker still on.
products.shortDescription: Live recordings, with the Rough Trade sticker still on.
products.fullDescription: Nils Frahm's Spaces, the 2014 Erased Tapes double LP of live recordings, bought new at Rough Trade in London around its release. The cream sleeve frames Frahm among his keyboards through a cut-out window. Up top, a scuffed, rundown white Rough Trade Essential sticker and the shop's own £21.99 tag are still on: the record carries its journey home. Sleeve clean and flat, likely still in shrink.
products.condition: Sleeve clean and flat; likely still in shrink; scuffed white Rough Trade Essential sticker and £21.99 tag kept on.

products.description: DOOM's diner, reopened. Twenty years on, sealed.

products.condition: Factory sealed, clean, hype sticker intact.
products.tags: mf-doom, mm-food, rhymesayers, vinyl, hip-hop, colored-vinyl

products.fullDescription: Sampha's debut, the 2017 Young Turks album that took the Mercury Prize. The cover is his portrait, eyes closed, on a warm cream ground, with PROCESS set in thin type beneath. Standard black single LP, factory sealed, the round black SAMPHA sticker still on the shrink.
